explain.sql: SELECT n.*,u.full_name AS student_name,u.identifier AS student_identifier,t.ticket_code,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notebook_cells c WHERE c.notebook_id=n.id) AS cells_count FROM notebooks n JOIN users u ON u.id=n.student_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=n.ticket_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT e.*,u.full_name AS student_name,u.identifier AS student_identifier,t.ticket_code,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_runs er WHERE er.experiment_id=e.id) AS runs_count FROM experiments e JOIN users u ON u.id=e.student_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=e.ticket_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT er.*,e.code AS experiment_code,e.name AS experiment_name,e.ticket_id,u.full_name AS student_name,u.identifier AS student_identifier,t.ticket_code FROM experiment_runs er JOIN experiments e ON e.id=er.experiment_id JOIN users u ON u.id=er.student_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=e.ticket_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY er.id DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT j.*,u.full_name AS student_name,u.identifier AS student_identifier,n.title AS notebook_title,n.ticket_id,t.ticket_code FROM execution_jobs j JOIN users u ON u.id=j.student_id JOIN notebooks n ON n.id=j.notebook_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=n.ticket_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT m.*,u.full_name AS student_name,u.identifier AS student_identifier,t.ticket_code,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_versions mv WHERE mv.model_id=m.id) AS versions_count FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.student_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=m.ticket_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT m.*,u.full_name AS student_name,u.identifier AS student_identifier,t.ticket_code,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_versions mv WHERE mv.model_id=m.id) AS versions_count FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.student_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=m.ticket_id WHERE 1=1 AND m.student_id=:student_id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

SELECT m.*, u.full_name as student_name, u.identifier as student_identifier,
                           s.title as scenario_title, t.ticket_code,
                           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_versions mv WHERE mv.model_id = m.id) as versions_count
                    FROM models m
                    JOIN users u ON m.student_id = u.id
                    LEFT JOIN scenarios s ON m.scenario_id = s.id
                    LEFT JOIN tickets t ON m.ticket_id = t.id
                    WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC

SELECT m.*, u.full_name as student_name, u.identifier as student_identifier,
                           s.title as scenario_title, t.ticket_code,
                           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_versions mv WHERE mv.model_id = m.id) as versions_count
                    FROM models m
                    JOIN users u ON m.student_id = u.id
                    LEFT JOIN scenarios s ON m.scenario_id = s.id
                    LEFT JOIN tickets t ON m.ticket_id = t.id
                    WHERE m.student_id = :s_id ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC

SELECT d.*,v.id AS dataset_version_id,v.version,v.format,v.file_path,v.file_size,v.checksum_sha256,v.row_count,v.column_count,v.schema_json,u.full_name AS uploader_name,s.title AS scenario_title,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_assignments a WHERE a.dataset_id=d.id AND a.revoked_at IS NULL) AS assignments_count
                FROM datasets d LEFT JOIN dataset_versions v ON v.id=d.current_version_id
                LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=d.uploaded_by LEFT JOIN scenarios s ON s.id=d.scenario_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC

SELECT d.*,v.id AS dataset_version_id,v.version,v.format,v.file_path,v.file_size,v.checksum_sha256,v.row_count,v.column_count,v.schema_json,u.full_name AS uploader_name,s.title AS scenario_title,
                a.ticket_id AS assigned_ticket_id,a.created_at AS assigned_at
                FROM datasets d JOIN dataset_assignments a ON a.dataset_id=d.id
                JOIN ticket_assignments ta ON ta.ticket_id=a.ticket_id AND ta.student_id=a.student_id AND ta.revoked_at IS NULL
                JOIN tickets t ON t.id=a.ticket_id AND t.status<>'CANCELLED'
                JOIN dataset_versions v ON v.id=a.dataset_version_id AND v.dataset_id=d.id
                LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=d.uploaded_by LEFT JOIN scenarios s ON s.id=d.scenario_id
                WHERE a.student_id=:uid AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.archived_at IS NULL
                AND a.id=(SELECT MAX(a2.id) FROM dataset_assignments a2
                    JOIN ticket_assignments ta2 ON ta2.ticket_id=a2.ticket_id AND ta2.student_id=a2.student_id AND ta2.revoked_at IS NULL
                    JOIN tickets t2 ON t2.id=a2.ticket_id AND t2.status<>'CANCELLED'
                    WHERE a2.dataset_id=d.id AND a2.student_id=:uid2 AND a2.revoked_at IS NULL) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC

SELECT t.*, s.title as scenario_title, s.code as scenario_code,
                           u.full_name as student_name, u.identifier as student_identifier, u.id as student_id,
                           creator.full_name as creator_name
                    FROM tickets t
                    LEFT JOIN scenarios s ON t.scenario_id = s.id
                    LEFT JOIN ticket_assignments ta ON t.id = ta.ticket_id AND ta.revoked_at IS NULL
                    LEFT JOIN users u ON ta.student_id = u.id
                    LEFT JOIN users creator ON t.created_by = creator.id
                    WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.*, s.title as scenario_title, s.code as scenario_code,
                           u.full_name as student_name, u.identifier as student_identifier, u.id as student_id,
                           creator.full_name as creator_name
                    FROM tickets t
                    JOIN ticket_assignments ta ON t.id = ta.ticket_id AND ta.revoked_at IS NULL
                    JOIN users u ON ta.student_id = u.id
                    LEFT JOIN scenarios s ON t.scenario_id = s.id
                    LEFT JOIN users creator ON t.created_by = creator.id
                    WHERE ta.student_id = :student_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
